nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

nexscope/inputExamples.prompt: Write a product description for a wireless speaker.

description: Creates a text-generation task from product copy instructions and image URLs, or queries a known task ID.

imageUrls.description: Media URLs used as context. Pass an empty array for text-only generation; use up to 10 images or typically one video.

memberId.description: Optional provider member identifier used by create and query.

model.description: Text-generation model. GEM_3_FLASH is the default.

prompt.description: Product-copy generation instruction; required by create.
prompt.example: Write a product description for a wireless speaker.

taskId.description: Provider task ID returned by create; required by operation=query.

thinkingLevel.description: Reasoning level required by create. GEM_3_1_PRO does not support minimal.
